summary.en: A printable page shown as a sheet inside the app: an invoice, a receipt, a letter, a certificate. The text reflows with the width, so the preview stays readable on a phone, and it can be the only thing that prints.
summary.id: Halaman yang bisa dicetak, ditampilkan sebagai lembar di dalam aplikasi: faktur, kuitansi, surat, sertifikat. Teksnya mengalir ulang mengikuti lebar, jadi pratinjau tetap terbaca di ponsel, dan bisa menjadi satu-satunya bagian yang dicetak.

en.title: Print only the paper
en.desc: Add `paper--print` and call `window.print()` from a Print button. The app around it does not print, and the sheet prints dark on white even in the dark theme.
